abstract: Urinary forms of human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) with oligosaccharides deficient in sialic acid content (ashCG) have been reported to be excreted by patients with choriocarcinoma in greater amounts than by healthy, pregnant women. Although ashCG potentially could be a useful marker for the diagnosis and management of gestational trophoblastic neoplasia, the methods previously used for its detection were not suitable for routine clinical application. Therefore, we have devised a simpler method which can provide specific and sensitive measurements of ashCG in urine. This method, which is designated as a lectin-immunoradiometric assay (LIRMA), employs an agarose-coupled lectin to selectively extract the ashCG, which is then quantified directly with a purified and radiolabelled rabbit antibody. The LIRMA has been applied to demonstrate that there is an increased excretion of ashCG by choriocarcinoma patients. It is also applicable, in principle, for the study of any glycoprotein which has a reduced content of sialic acid in its carbohydrate side chains.
abstract_ja: 絨毛癌の患者では、糖鎖のシアル酸含量が低下したヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(ashCG)の尿中排泄が、健常妊婦よりも多いと報告されている。ashCGは妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の診断と管理における有用なマーカーとなる可能性があるが、従来の検出法は日常的な臨床応用に適していなかった。そこで、より簡便な方法を考案した。本法は、寒天に結合させたレクチンを用いてashCGを選択的に抽出し、精製・放射標識したウサギ抗体で直接定量するレクチン免疫放射定量法(LIRMA)である。LIRMAを適用した結果、絨毛癌患者ではashCGの排泄が増加していることが示された。原理的には、糖鎖のシアル酸含量が低下した他の糖蛋白質の研究にも適用可能である。
